sloka: श्रुत्वा एतस्य पुरा शब्दम् आश्रमस्था मम प्रिया ।माम् आहूय प्रमुदिता परमम् प्रत्यनन्दत ॥४-१-२५॥
transliteration: śrutvā etasya purā śabdam āśramasthā mama priyā ।mām āhūya pramuditā paramam pratyanandata ॥4-1-25॥

translations.english: 'While in the hermitage in the past, my beloved was very glad to hear such sounds, invite me to join her and rejoice again.
